figures.finding: In Tanzania every film practitioner, actors and directors included, must be registered and licensed by the Tanzania Film Board: accreditation and a practitioner's ID card cost TZS 30,000 for three years, issued once the application form and attachments are approved. No actors' collective agreement or minimum rate was found.

value.body: Bodi ya Filamu Tanzania (Tanzania Film Board)

figures.applies: Tanzania, all film practitioners, as published 2025-2026.

sources.said: Watendaji wote katika filamu, wafanyabiashara, majumba ya sinema na studio zinatakiwa kusajiliwa na kupatiwa leseni ya uendeshaji wa shughuli zao kutoka Bodi ya Filamu Tanzania.

Wahusika ni wadau wote wanaojishughulisha na shughuli zozote za filamu, michezo ya kuigiza, matangazo, biashara ya filamu, utayarishaji, uigizaji, uongozaji, utafutaji mandhari na shughuli nyingine kama hizo. … Kujaza fomu ya maombi Kuwasilisha fomu ikiwa na viambatisho vilivyoainishwa Kitambulisho kinatolewa baada ya maombi kuridhiwa Ada TZS 30,000/= kwa miaka 3

figures.finding: The Tanzania Film Board, which licenses all film work, sits in Dar es Salaam; no source measuring where most work is made was found.

value.basis: seat of the Film Board, not a production count

sources.said: Bodi ya Filamu Tanzania Barabara ya Kivukoni, Utumishi, Kitalu H, S.L.P 79241, DAR ES SALAAM.

figures.finding: The Film Board publishes in Kiswahili, and Tanzania's Constitution requires a Member of Parliament to read and write Kiswahili or English; no source names the language screen work is made in.

value.basis: constitutional language requirement for MPs and the regulator's working language, not a statement on film

sources.said: who can read and write in Kiswahili or English
